subproblem.title: Integer multiplicity from a rectifiable carrier with a.e. integer density and oriented approximate tangent planes
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), M ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel set that is countably n-rectifiable (SimonGMT CountablyRectifiable n M), θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel measurable with θ > 0 on M and ∫⁻_M ofReal(θ) dHⁿ < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), and ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) strongly measurable, such that Γ(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every test n-form ω on ℝ^P. Suppose that for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4), ζ(x) a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q) and θ(x) = m for some m ∈ ℕ. Then Γ is an integer multiplicity current (IsIntegerMultiplicity Γ): some IMRep R in ℝ^P represents Γ.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, θ x = m) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Γ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 4–7 of the parent proof of cbr_ci_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_ae_tangent (assembly of the IMRep), with the countable n-rectifiability of M (step 3 there, obtained from (RECT)) taken as a hypothesis. Step 5 there is the sibling theorem (NI) = hasApproximateTangentSpaceAt_iff_of_null_sdiff, used exactly as stated.

Notation. Hⁿ := μHE[n]. For x ∈ ℝ^P let p(x) be the statement: there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q, and θ(x) = m for some m ∈ ℕ. By hypothesis p holds Hⁿ⌞M-a.e.

1. The bad set is null. As M is measurable, the statement that p(x) holds for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x is equivalent to the statement that x ∈ M → p(x) holds for Hⁿ-a.e. x (ae_restrict_iff'), i.e. B := {x : x ∈ M and not p(x)} satisfies Hⁿ(B) = 0 (ae_iff).

2. A Borel carrier of full measure. Let N₀ := toMeasurable(Hⁿ, B): N₀ is measurable, B ⊆ N₀ and Hⁿ(N₀) = Hⁿ(B) = 0 (measurableSet_toMeasurable, subset_toMeasurable, measure_toMeasurable). Put M'' := M ∖ N₀. Then M'' is measurable and M'' ⊆ M. Every x ∈ M'' satisfies p(x): otherwise x ∈ M and not p(x), so x ∈ B ⊆ N₀, contradicting x ∉ N₀. Moreover M ∖ M'' ⊆ N₀ (if x ∈ M and x ∉ M ∖ N₀ then x ∈ N₀), so Hⁿ(M ∖ M'') = 0; and M'' ∖ M = ∅, so Hⁿ(M'' ∖ M) = 0.

3. Tangent spaces of M''. By (NI) with A := M and B := M'' (both differences are Hⁿ-null by step 2), for every x and every subspace Q: HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q holds iff HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M'' x Q holds.

4. The multiplicity. Define mult(x) := ⌊θ(x)⌋₊ (natural-number floor) for x ∈ M'' and mult(x) := 0 otherwise. Measurability: ⌊·⌋₊ : ℝ → ℕ is monotone (Nat.floor_mono), hence Borel measurable (Monotone.measurable), so x ↦ ⌊θ(x)⌋₊ is measurable; the piecewise definition over the measurable set M'' is measurable (Measurable.ite). For x ∈ M'', p(x) gives θ(x) = m with m ∈ ℕ, so ⌊θ(x)⌋₊ = m and (mult(x) : ℝ) = θ(x).

5. The IMRep fields. Let R have carrier M'', multiplicity mult and orientation ζ.
(a) measurableSet_carrier: step 2.
(b) carrier_subset: M'' ⊆ ℝ^P = univ.
(c) rectifiable: M'' ⊆ M and M is countably n-rectifiable, so M'' is (CountablyRectifiable.mono).
(d) measurable_mult: step 4.
(e) mult_pos: for x ∈ M'' ⊆ M, (mult(x) : ℝ) = θ(x) > 0, hence mult(x) > 0 in ℕ.
(f) locallyIntegrable_mult: for every compact K ⊆ univ, ∫⁻_{M''∩K} mult dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_{M''} mult dHⁿ (monotonicity in the set, lintegral_mono_set) = ∫⁻_{M''} ofReal(θ) dHⁿ (on M'', (mult(x) : ℝ≥0∞) = ofReal((mult(x) : ℝ)) = ofReal(θ(x)) by ENNReal.ofReal_natCast and step 4; setLIntegral_congr_fun on the measurable set M'') ≤ ∫⁻_M ofReal(θ) dHⁿ (M'' ⊆ M) < ∞.
(g) aestronglyMeasurable_orient: ζ is strongly measurable, hence a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M''.
(h) orients: since M'' is measurable, it suffices to treat every x ∈ M'' (ae_restrict_iff'). For x ∈ M'', p(x) gives Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q; by step 3, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M'' x Q.

6. Representation. Since Hⁿ(M ∖ M'') = 0 = Hⁿ(M'' ∖ M), the sets M and M'' are Hⁿ-a.e. equal (ae_eq_set), so Hⁿ⌞M = Hⁿ⌞M'' (Measure.restrict_congr_set). For every test form ω on ℝ^P: Γ(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ = ∫_{M''} θ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ = ∫_{M''} (mult(x) : ℝ)ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ = R.action(ω), the third equality because the integrands agree on the measurable set M'' by step 4 (setIntegral_congr_fun). Hence R represents Γ (IMRep.Represents), and Γ is integer multiplicity. ∎

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition with lake env lean in the contract scope — `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, `namespace GMT.Ch07` and the contract's opens — after the accepted candidate declaration of the sibling theorem; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; the statement line is the frozen type verbatim; Measurable.nat_floor is not imported by the contract, hence Nat.floor_mono.measurable):
theorem Submission.cbr_ci_imc_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_rectifiable : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, θ x = m) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Γ := by
  intro P n Γ M θ ζ hM hrect hθ hζ hpos hint hrep hae
  classical
  set p : Euclid P → Prop := fun x => ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
    HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, θ x = m with hp
  have hbad : μHE[n] {x | x ∈ M ∧ ¬ p x} = 0 := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hM, ae_iff] at hae
    simpa only [not_imp] using hae
  set N₀ := toMeasurable (μHE[n]) {x | x ∈ M ∧ ¬ p x} with hN₀_def
  have hN₀m : MeasurableSet N₀ := measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _
  have hN₀ : μHE[n] N₀ = 0 := by rw [hN₀_def, measure_toMeasurable]; exact hbad
  set M'' := M \ N₀ with hM''_def
  have hM''m : MeasurableSet M'' := hM.diff hN₀m
  have hM''sub : M'' ⊆ M := Set.sdiff_subset
  have hgood : ∀ x ∈ M'', p x := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx.2 (subset_toMeasurable _ _ ⟨hx.1, h⟩)
  have hdiff : μHE[n] (M \ M'') = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx => ?_) hN₀
    by_contra h
    exact hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
  have hdiff' : μHE[n] (M'' \ M) = 0 := by
    rw [Set.sdiff_eq_empty.2 hM''sub, measure_empty]
  let mult : Euclid P → ℕ := fun x => if x ∈ M'' then ⌊θ x⌋₊ else 0
  have hmult_eq : ∀ x ∈ M'', (mult x : ℝ) = θ x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨Q, -, -, m, hm⟩ := hgood x hx
    simp [mult, hx, hm]
  have hmult_meas : Measurable mult :=
    Measurable.ite hM''m (Nat.floor_mono.measurable.comp hθ) measurable_const
  have hmult_pos : ∀ x ∈ M'', 0 < mult x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2 := hpos x (hM''sub hx)
    rw [← hmult_eq x hx] at h2
    exact_mod_cast h2
  have hmult_int : ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ univ →
      ∫⁻ x in M'' ∩ K, (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ := by
    intro K _ _
    apply ne_of_lt
    calc ∫⁻ x in M'' ∩ K, (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n]
        ≤ ∫⁻ x in M'', (mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] := lintegral_mono_set inter_subset_left
      _ = ∫⁻ x in M'', ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hM''m
        intro x hx
        simp only
        rw [← hmult_eq x hx, ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] := lintegral_mono_set hM''sub
      _ < ∞ := hint
  have horients : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M''), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M'' x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hM''m]
    refine Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hor, -⟩ := hgood x hx
    exact ⟨Q, (Submission.hasApproximateTangentSpaceAt_iff_of_null_sdiff P n M M'' x Q
      hdiff hdiff').1 hQ, hor⟩
  let R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n :=
    { carrier := M''
      mult := mult
      orient := ζ
      measurableSet_carrier := hM''m
      carrier_subset := subset_univ _
      rectifiable := hrect.mono hM''sub
      measurable_mult := hmult_meas
      mult_pos := hmult_pos
      locallyIntegrable_mult := hmult_int
      aestronglyMeasurable_orient := hζ.aestronglyMeasurable
      orients := horients }
  refine ⟨R, fun ω => ?_⟩
  rw [hrep ω]
  have hres : μHE[n].restrict M = μHE[n].restrict M'' :=
    Measure.restrict_congr_set (ae_eq_set.2 ⟨hdiff, hdiff'⟩)
  show _ = ∫ x in M'', (mult x : ℝ) * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]
  rw [hres]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun hM''m (fun x hx => ?_)
  simp only [hmult_eq x hx]
proof_key_steps: The bad set {x ∈ M : no oriented approximate tangent plane or θ(x) ∉ ℕ} is Hⁿ-null; removing its measurable hull N₀ gives a Borel M'' = M ∖ N₀ ⊆ M of full measure on which the good property holds at every point.
(NI): M and M'' differ by Hⁿ-null sets, so they have the same approximate tangent spaces at every point.

mult := ⌊θ⌋₊ on M'' (0 elsewhere) is measurable, equals θ and is positive on M'', and is locally integrable because ∫⁻_M ofReal θ dHⁿ < ∞; M'' is rectifiable as a subset of M; ζ orients the approximate tangent plane of M'' at every point of M''.
Hⁿ⌞M = Hⁿ⌞M'' and mult = θ on M'', so the IMRep (M'', mult, ζ) represents Γ.

subproblem.title: A.e. strong measurability of an approximate-tangent-plane projection field
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set (measurability is not assumed) with Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let Q be any map from ℝ^P to the linear subspaces of ℝ^P such that, for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every x, Q(x) is an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x): dim Q(x) = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_{Q(x)} f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is blowUpMap x r). Then the field of orthogonal projections x ↦ p_{Q(x)} = (Q x).starProjection ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable for μHE[n].restrict M).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1–2 of the parent proof of cbr_ci_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_ae_tangent (measurability of the tangent-plane field), stated for an arbitrary a.e. approximate-tangent field Q instead of approxTangentPlane n M; the parent applies it with Q := approxTangentPlane n M. Steps 2(a), 2(b) and 2(d) of that proof are the sibling theorems (QM) = exists_plane_cutoff_quadratic_moment_eq, (BC) = continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral and (PF) = aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq, used exactly as stated; step 2(c) is carried out below.

Notation. Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P; μ := Hⁿ⌞M = μHE[n].restrict M; p_x := (Q x).starProjection; η_{x,r} := blowUpMap x r, η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x); ∫_A g dHⁿ := ∫ g d(Hⁿ⌞A). Let G be the set of x with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x); by hypothesis G holds μ-a.e.

1. Case n = 0. For x ∈ G the dimension clause of the definition gives finrank Q(x) = 0, hence Q(x) = ⊥ (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero), and p_x is the orthogonal projection onto the zero subspace, i.e. p_x v = 0 for every v, so p_x = 0. Thus x ↦ p_x agrees μ-a.e. with the constant map 0, which is strongly measurable, and a function μ-a.e. equal to an a.e. strongly measurable function is a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable.congr). This proves the claim for n = 0. From now on n ≥ 1.

2. The plane moments. By (QM) (applicable since n ≥ 1) there is c > 0 such that for every linear subspace Q' ⊆ ℝ^P with finrank Q' = n and every u ∈ ℝ^P: ∫_{Q'} max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u, y⟩² dHⁿ(y) = c|p_{Q'} u|².

3. The test function. Fix u ∈ ℝ^P and put f_u(y) := max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u, y⟩². It is continuous (built from the norm, the inner product, max and products). If |y| > 1 then 1 − |y|² < 0, so max(1 − |y|², 0) = 0 and f_u(y) = 0; hence f_u vanishes outside the compact closed unit ball and has compact support (HasCompactSupport.intro). So f_u defines an element F_u ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ) with F_u(y) = f_u(y) for all y.

4. A sequence of radii. Put r_k := 1/(k + 1), k ∈ ℕ. Then r_k > 0 and r_k → 0 (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat); since every r_k lies in (0, ∞), r_k → 0 along the filter 𝓝[>] 0 (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff).

5. Measurable approximants. For k ∈ ℕ let Φ_k(x) := ∫_{η_{x,r_k}(M)} f_u dHⁿ. By (BC), applied to M (its hypothesis Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K is exactly ours), to the continuous compactly supported f_u and to r_k > 0, each Φ_k is continuous on ℝ^P, hence Borel measurable, hence μ-a.e. measurable.

6. Pointwise limits. Let x ∈ G. Applying the definition of HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x) to the test function F_u gives ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f_u dHⁿ → ∫_{Q(x)} f_u dHⁿ as r → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0; composing with step 4, Φ_k(x) → ∫_{Q(x)} f_u dHⁿ as k → ∞. The dimension clause gives finrank Q(x) = n, so by step 2 this limit is c|p_x u|². Hence Φ_k(x) → c|p_x u|² for μ-a.e. x.

7. Quadratic forms are a.e. measurable. A μ-a.e. limit of a sequence of μ-a.e. measurable real functions is μ-a.e. measurable (aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae'). By steps 5–6, x ↦ c|p_x u|² is μ-a.e. measurable; multiplying by the constant c⁻¹ (c > 0) shows that x ↦ |p_x u|² = c⁻¹·(c|p_x u|²) is μ-a.e. measurable. This holds for every u ∈ ℝ^P.

8. The projection field. By (PF), applied to the measure μ and the field K := Q, step 7 implies that x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. measurable as a map into L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) with its Borel σ-algebra.

9. Strong measurability. L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is a finite-dimensional normed space, hence metrizable and second countable, and its σ-algebra is the Borel one; for such targets a.e. measurability implies a.e. strong measurability (AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable). Hence x ↦ (Q x).starProjection is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable. ∎

theorem Submission.cbr_ci_imc_tangent_field_aestronglyMeasurable : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) := by
  intro P n M Q hloc htan
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · refine (aestronglyMeasurable_const (b := (0 : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P))).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [htan] with x hx
    have h0 : Q x = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.1 hx.1
    rw [h0]
    ext v
    simp
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hmom⟩ := Submission.exists_plane_cutoff_quadratic_moment_eq n hn
    apply AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    apply Submission.aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq
    intro u
    set f : Euclid P → ℝ := fun y => max (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) 0 * inner ℝ u y ^ 2 with hf_def
    have hfc : Continuous f := by
      simp only [hf_def]
      fun_prop
    have hfs : HasCompactSupport f := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Euclid P) 1)
      intro y hy
      simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
      have h1 : 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
      simp [hf_def, max_eq_right h1]
    let F : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ := ⟨⟨f, hfc⟩, hfs⟩
    let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
    have hrpos : ∀ k, 0 < r k := fun k => by positivity
    have hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat,
        Eventually.of_forall hrpos⟩
    have hmeas : ∀ k, AEMeasurable (fun x => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x (r k) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) (μHE[n].restrict M) := fun k =>
      (Submission.continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral P n M hloc f hfc hfs (r k) (hrpos k)).measurable.aemeasurable
    have hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x (r k) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (c * ‖(Q x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2)) := by
      filter_upwards [htan] with x hx
      rw [← hmom P (Q x) hx.1 u]
      exact (hx.2 F).comp hr
    have h1 : AEMeasurable (fun x => c * ‖(Q x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2) (μHE[n].restrict M) :=
      aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae' hmeas hlim
    refine (h1.const_mul c⁻¹).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_mul]
proof_key_steps: n = 0: at a.e. x the plane Q(x) has dimension 0, so Q(x) = ⊥ and p_{Q(x)} = 0 a.e.
n ≥ 1: (QM) gives c > 0 with ∫_{Q'} f_u dHⁿ = c|p_{Q'}u|² for every n-plane Q', where f_u(y) = max(1−|y|²,0)⟨u,y⟩² is continuous with compact support.
(BC): Φ_k(x) = ∫_{η_{x,1/(k+1)}(M)} f_u dHⁿ is continuous in x; at a.e. x the tangent-space definition gives Φ_k(x) → c|p_{Q(x)}u|².
Hence x ↦ |p_{Q(x)}u|² is a.e. measurable for every u (a.e. limit of measurable functions, divided by c > 0).
(PF) gives a.e. measurability of x ↦ p_{Q(x)}, which is a.e. strong measurability in the finite-dimensional space L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P).
